messages.subject: Next Meetings ( November / December / January )
parts:
Hi there

At the meeting last night, we decided to arrange dates for another
three meetings. The dates are

November - Thursday 17th November 6.30-8.00
December - Thursday 15th December 6.30-8.00
January - Thursday 19th January 6.30 -8.00

The venue will be "The Bank" on College Green. I had booked a table
last night, but for the next one I am just going to go in an grab one
early - near the fireplace on the left hand side, directly as you walk
in the door.

I am going to have a laminate of the R symbol to identify ourselves.

Regards
Kevin O'Brien
